title: Evidence Packet
description: Structured evidence for verification, audit, recovery, and regression. This is not an explanation field.

evidence_id.description: Stable identifier for this Evidence Packet.

episode_id.description: Episode Journal identifier this evidence belongs to.

step_id.description: Execution step identifier this evidence supports.

pre_state_hash.description: Accepted state hash before the action.

pre_state_summary.description: Summary of accepted state before the action.

action_ref.description: Reference to the ExecutionStep or action record.

observation.description: Structured observation, diff, or tool/environment output normalized for verification.

post_state_summary.description: Summary of accepted or candidate post-action state.

post_state_hash.description: Accepted or candidate state hash after the action.

verifier_result.description: Verifier output associated with this evidence, when available.

provenance.description: Source, runtime, tool, environment, document, or version metadata backing the evidence.

runtime_context.description: Runtime metadata needed to interpret this evidence packet.

evidence_phase.description: G10 COMMITTABLE evidence phase. Historical non-G10 packets may omit it.

target_identity.description: Typed target identity for a governed side effect.
